name: capture_screen

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_CaptureScreen takes no Script context and does not access the value stack

notes: ScriptCommand_CaptureScreen schedules func_00109AA0, which configures a GS store-image transfer for the full 512x384 framebuffer at base 0x1A00 and copies it to the transition scratch buffer at func_F20000. The paired graphics path reloads that buffer as two 512x192 textures for screen-transition blending. The JP corpus contains 214 calls, commonly adjacent to command 513 enable_event_camera.
